It does not satisfy the market-data dependency in the tonight-prep blocker list; that still requires the Odds API / Kalshi credential decision recorded there.

best_odds.note: Different lines per side; not one coherent market.

movement_open_to_consensus.spread_direction: CHI -1.5 at open to PHI -3.5 at consensus; five points toward Philadelphia.
movement_open_to_consensus.moneyline_direction: PHI de-vigged win probability moved from 0.4826 to 0.6386.
movement_open_to_consensus.interpretation_note: A five-point spread move toward the road team combined with a four-point total decline is the signature of a material team-news event on the Chicago side, but no cause is established here. Do not record a cause until it is confirmed against an official injury report, inactives list or team release. The OPEN values are as displayed by BettingPros and were not corroborated against a second opening-line source.

coverage.not_captured_reason: Out of scope for this manual pass. Capturing prop and alternate-line ladders at depth would require repeated extraction across many pages, which the source rights do not permit without a written agreement.

licensed_path_note: Kalshi and Polymarket appear as columns on this board and are both already registered Runner providers (DATA_SOURCE_REGISTRY.md). Their prices for this event can be obtained directly from their own public interfaces under Runner's existing provider path, which would make them ingestible rather than reference-only. That is the supported route to a real market comparison for this game, and it requires no BettingPros data.
boundary: BettingPros is a reference and inspiration target, not a data source. No BettingPros projection, rating, grade, pick, bet percentage, system output or other proprietary computation is stored here. The values recorded are sportsbook and prediction-market prices displayed on a board Runner's owner is entitled to view, plus the platform's own OPEN, BEST ODDS and CONSENSUS aggregate columns, which are retained solely as observed context and are explicitly marked model_input_approved false.
